FIX: make the pattern accept any single JavaScript identifier as the const name (`const\s+[A-Za-z_$][\w$]*\s*=\s*asString\(env\.CF_AI_MODEL\)...`), still requiring the CF_AI_MODEL fallback form and a quoted default, and still failing loudly on a source without it. TEST FIRST: add to tests/test_environment_baseline.py two cases for parse_worker_default_model: the new `configuredModel` form returns '@cf/meta/llama-3.1-8b-instruct-fast', and the old `model` form still works; keep the existing fails-loudly test unchanged. Run, see the new case fail, fix. FINISH: ruff check and ruff format both files; report pass counts.
